plainTranslation: With Composite Uranus in the 9th house, you can expand and explore together in ways that you wouldn’t normally alone or with others. You can be more open to individuality and eccentricities. The issue with this placement is that you may have a hard time sticking together as you give each other a little too much space. Travel together, learn together, laugh together, and be positive together.
policy: Composite chart entries describe the relationship as a third entity. Read alongside synastry; do not use as a verdict on whether a relationship should continue.
